title: Repeated answers can agree by chance
hook: Two stated cases for repeated answers can agree by chance.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the all-agree probability under independent identical answer draws affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Probability, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the all-agree probability under independent identical answer draws in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
